_source: gate numbers that are not a row's parameter: the window or step a measurement is made with and the cut-offs of the score and preflight checks. scripts/gate_constants.py reads them; a project overrides one by name in <project>/presets/gate/constants.json ({"name": value}). A number a row judges a piece by belongs in rows.json instead (AGENTS.md rule 18). Algorithm constants (sample rates, filter orders, FFT sizes, epsilons) stay in code on purpose.

preflight.sfx_min_fraction.source: starting value: a one-shot must be allowed this share of its length before the next onset or its own end

preflight.unison_min_beats.source: starting value: both notes this long, overlapping this long, before two sampled unisons are reported as beating

preflight.unison_min_pitch.source: starting value: MIDI 60 (middle C); below it a unison is a doubling, not a beat

preflight.quiet_energy.source: starting value: a section is quiet when its declared energy is under this share of the loudest section's

preflight.quiet_share.source: starting value: a figure part is a quiet-section part when this share of its note time is in quiet sections

preflight.placement_min_shared.source: starting value: share of the shorter part's playing time that two parts share before they compete for one place

preflight.sparse_max_beats.source: starting value: an event longer than this many beats is a bed, not a sparse sound

score.gap_beats.source: starting value: a breath or bow gap is at least this many beats

score.window_bars.source: starting value: the phrase window, in bars, a breath or bow gap is looked for in

clicks.step.source: starting value: a one-sample jump this big (full scale 1.0) is no note attack; a sample that starts mid-wave makes one

masking.window_s.source: starting value: the congestion check looks at windows this long, in seconds

z_separation.band_hz.source: starting value: where strings, brass and a bright synth lead all sit

z_separation.frame_s.source: starting value: band-envelope resolution for the overlap measure

roughness.relative.source: starting value: a roughness spike must also stand this far above the piece's own median

roughness.outro_ratio.source: starting value: the last 3 s must not be rougher than the piece's median by more than this

roughness.peak_prominence_db.source: measured: random noise peaks reach about 11 dB above the local floor, so a roughness peak must stand 15 dB above it

roughness.audible_db.source: starting value: a partial this far under the frame's loudest cannot make roughness audible

chroma.sounding_db.source: starting value: a frame this far under the loudest frame is not sounding

realism.sub_loss_max_db.source: starting value: the 20-60 Hz share the master keeps may be at most this far under the share the carrying stems hold together

realism.sub_carrier_db.source: starting value: a stem whose 20-60 Hz share of its own power is above this carries the sub (the 'Sub < 60 Hz: only kick and bass' band of references/mixing/mixing-and-mastering.md)

preflight.master_hp_max_hz.source: starting value: a master high-pass above this removes the sub the score writes (references/mixing/mixing-and-mastering.md: sub is below 60 Hz and belongs to kick and bass); the shipped default is 24 Hz

preflight.master_hp_lost_db.source: starting value: a note whose fundamental the master high-pass takes down by this much is lost, not shaped

preflight.master_hp_lost_share.source: starting value: a bass or drum part with this share of its notes lost to the master high-pass fails the preflight
